chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Abū Khālid, from Abū Ḥamzah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
“A man should not wash a woman, unless no woman is found.”

key_terms.إِلَّا: except; indicating an exception to the rule
key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; the male person addressed in the ruling
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman; the female deceased being washed
key_terms.يُغَسِّلُ: performs the ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: Can a man perform the ritual washing of a deceased woman if no woman is available?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the washing of a deceased woman. It states that a man does not wash a woman except in the case where no woman is available, indicating an exception based on necessity.
